subject: Geografia
description_pt: Utilizar as direções cardeais na localização de componentes físicos e humanos nas paisagens rurais e urbanas.

components.description_pt: Identificar as quatro direções cardinais em um mapa ou em uma paisagem
components.description_en: Identify the four cardinal directions on a map or in a landscape
components.cc_component_description: Create a simple map showing the location of land and water features in a given area

components.description_pt: Aplicar direções cardinais para localizar características físicas em paisagens rurais e urbanas
components.description_en: Apply cardinal directions to locate physical features in rural and urban landscapes
components.cc_component_description: Interpret a map to locate major mountain chains and describe their positions relative to continental edges

cc_matches.description: Maps show where things are located. One can map the shapes and kinds of land and water in any area.

The locations of mountain ranges, deep ocean trenches, ocean floor structures, earthquakes, and volcanoes occur in patterns. Most earthquakes and volcanoes occur in bands that are often along the boundaries between continents and oceans. Major mountain chains form inside continents or near their edges. Maps can help locate the different land and water features areas of Earth.
